presets.name: Software team
presets.description: Everything on: tasks, code, runs, agents and planning.
presets.tone: A software team. Technical terms are fine.

presets.name: Startup
presets.description: A small team shipping fast: tasks, chat, code and agents, without the heavier planning.
presets.tone: A small team moving fast. Keep it short and practical.

presets.name: Personal life
presets.description: Your own life: to-dos, notes, goals and dates, with nothing that feels like work software.
presets.tone: Someone's personal life. Use plain, warm, everyday words, and avoid software and project-management terms.

presets.name: Household
presets.description: A shared home: chores, shopping, bills and plans, for everyone who lives there.
presets.tone: A household sharing chores and plans. Use plain, friendly words.

presets.name: Bug reporting
presets.description: Just the list of bugs and a way to add one, for people who report problems.
presets.tone: Someone reporting bugs. Ask what they did, what they expected and what happened instead, and skip internal jargon.

presets.name: Simple to-do list
presets.description: One list of things to do, with due dates.
presets.tone: A simple to-do list. Keep replies short.

presets.name: Kanban
presets.description: A board of cards moving across columns, with labels and priorities.
presets.tone: A kanban board, where work is cards moving across columns.

presets.name: Writing
presets.description: Drafts and notes first, with a short list of what's left to do.
presets.tone: A writing project. Talk about drafts, edits and ideas in plain language.

presets.name: Research
presets.description: Notes, findings and sources, with agents to help dig.
presets.tone: A research project. Be precise, cite sources, and keep findings apart from guesses.

presets.name: School
presets.description: Classes, assignments and exam dates, with notes and study groups.
presets.tone: A student's coursework. Be clear and encouraging.

presets.name: Event planning
presets.description: Plan an event: to-dos with deadlines, a timeline and who's doing what.
presets.tone: Planning an event. Keep track of dates, people and logistics, in plain words.

presets.name: Content calendar
presets.description: Posts moving from idea to published, with drafts and publish dates.
presets.tone: A content calendar. Talk about ideas, drafts and publish dates.

presets.name: Support desk
presets.description: Tickets coming in from people and other apps, sorted and answered.
presets.tone: A support desk handling tickets. Be courteous and concrete.

presets.name: Agent lab
presets.description: Agents and runs first: hand tasks to agents, follow their runs and compare results.
presets.tone: An agent lab for trying out agents and runs. Technical detail is welcome.

presets.name: Planning only
presets.description: Plan the work: tasks, milestones, a timeline and dependencies, without the doing.
presets.tone: Planning work: scope, order and dates. Plan the tasks, don't start doing them.

presets.name: Stakeholder
presets.description: Mostly reading: progress, milestones, decisions and pages, without the working parts.
presets.tone: A stakeholder following progress. Summarize plainly: what's done, what's next and what's at risk.

presets.name: Minimal
presets.description: Just tasks and chat, nothing else.
